descriptionHtml:
Bug B06 · P0 · known

After dictating 'furosemide down to 20', the tracker row still says 'Furosemide 40'; the dose is not updated

Tickets: TFA-92597 ready for qa (R7) · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev

Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S07 Hospital, live: pre-round list seeds the tracker, then one encounter with a hold, a dose change, a one-time dose, an imperative start and a continue, saved twice on the same text

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 The pre-round medication list and the encounter Medication Tracker are one set of rows: a row the pre-round Save Note writes shows in the Post-Round tracker and a change from Save & Extract shows on … (UAT TC-19; TFA-92597 What; TFA-92597 AC 3)
  • U4 'Continue / keep / stays on X' is not an event: no re-dating, no Held, no new row. (UAT TC-19 ER 1; TFA-92597 R4)
  • U6 'Let's start X' is a plan: it becomes a task, not a row. (UAT TC-19 ER 3; TFA-92597 R3)
  • U7 A dose change renames the row to the new dose and keeps its history (the old dose stays readable on the row). (UAT TC-19 ER 4; TFA-92597 R7)
  • U8 Hold/stop dates and reasons are the ones dictated and are kept on every later save; they are never changed to the save date. (UAT TC-19 ER 5; UAT TC-19 ER 10; TFA-92597 R6)
  • U11 'Gave one-time X' → a single-dose row shown as Given that expires; the standing order of the same drug is untouched. (UAT TC-19 ER 8; TFA-92597 R2)
  • U13 A repeat hold on a held drug changes nothing; a held or stopped row never resets to active unless a restart is dictated. (UAT TC-19 ER 9; TFA-92597 R5)
  • U18 The step mix (starts, holds, stops, dose changes, conditional orders, one-time doses) is dictated across two days and passes in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-19 Steps; UAT 3.3)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh physician with the fixture Hospital patient (no medications); live models on the local stack

When Pre-Round: type the pre-round text and Save Note. Encounter: type the encounter text and Save & Extract, then Save & Extract again on the same text (the former S17), and reload. Look at Post-Round → meds, Post-Round → tasks, then the Pre-Round Medications panel

Then Pre-Round panel lists the four drugs. After both saves and the reload: exactly five rows, one each for apixaban, furosemide, magnesium, metoprolol and atorvastatin (no second Given row, no re-applied hold); apixaban is Held · today with a reason naming the procedure; the furosemide row's NAME carries 20 and its history keeps 40; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint (case-insensitive page-wide substrings): drug names present, no metolazone row, no Started/Stopped tag, a task naming metolazone, no 'extraction failed'. What page-wide substrings cannot see is in spec.manual and in each checkpoint's rowChecks: exactly five rows, exactly one row per drug, the furosemide row NAME has 20 and not 40, no tag on the metopr …

Where it ran: dev unit U40; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-19.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment dev · tickets TFA-92597 ready for qa

After the physician dictates 'reduce furosemide to 20' and taps Save & Extract, the tracker row still reads 'Furosemide 40' instead of being renamed to the new dose.

Evidence: Allure 8c1de1c9. The result says 'known: TFA-92597 R7'. Ledger #40 U40: 'Fail (known)'. Dev report §4. mergeMedEventsIntoList does not rename the row. Q18 (does R7 cover Save & Extract; Tim's spec expects the old name) is recorded too. The hold, repeat hold and task parts pass.
